Mark resource instances for replacement — `tofu taint`: the next up plans each one's object destroyed and created again. A state edit, applied at once (no plan, no approval).

**[Tiers](/docs/reference/server/#tiers):** full

## Annotations

| Annotation | Value |
|---|---|
| `readOnlyHint` | false |
| `destructiveHint` | true |
| `idempotentHint` | false |
| `openWorldHint` | true |

## Arguments

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `workspace_alias` | string | no | Workspace alias, as 'open' named it. Omit for the workspace opened without an alias ('default'), however many others are open. |
| `addrs` | array of string | yes | Resource instance addresses (e.g. 'aws_instance.web', 'module.m.aws_instance.x[0]'). |
